description: Morning Cortisol Detox | Bansuri Raga Bhairavi 432Hz | 1.5 Hours — soft morning flute to lower the stress response before the day starts.

Ninety minutes of slow bansuri in Raga Bhairavi, the raga of dawn, tuned to 432Hz over a warm tanpura drone. Nothing sudden, nothing to follow — just a calm bed of sound for the first hour of the day, when cortisol is highest.
🎧 HOW TO USE — play low on waking, through your morning routine. Loops seamlessly.
⏱ BEST FOR — stressful mornings · morning anxiety · lowering cortisol · a calm start · nervous system reset
🎵 ABOUT — Raga Bhairavi is traditionally played at dawn; its soft, descending phrases on bansuri settle the breath and the body.
